description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is a Keyed Alike Lock Set consisting of the Drivers Door Lock, Passengers Door Lock and a Locking Fuel/Gas Cap.
Comes with 2 Keys Comes with NON-LOCKING Glove Box Door Lock
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Door Lock Cylinder – Driver’s Side
Qty 1 – Door Lock Cylinder – Passenger’s Side
Qty 1 – Locking Gas Cap
Qty 2 – Keys
—– ALL ABOVE KEYED ALIKE —–
—– ADDITIONAL LOCK PARTS —-
Qty 1 – Glove Box Latch – Non Locking
Qty 2 – Attachment Clips – Latch Rod
Qty 2 – Attachment Clips – Lock Cylinder
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
